title: Which class had full attendance that day?
description: Full attendance means no student was absent, so the class to find has a bar of height zero. Keeko's doubt, that a class with no bar was left out of the graph, is checked against what zero means on the scale.
teaching_notes: One idea: a bar of height zero is a real value and means none, so a missing bar is not missing data. Watch for students who say that the class with no bar was not counted.

source: Which class had full attendance that day? ___
video_script.why: The child learns that zero is a value a bar can show, with no visible bar, and that it means none.
video_script.substitution: Look for the class where the number of students absent is zero, which has no bar to see.
video_script.anchor: the bar graph of students absent in each class, with one unit of length for one student
video_script.wrong_answer: Class five has no bar, so its count was left out
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko thinks a class with no bar was not counted. A bar of height zero is too small to see, and it means no student was absent.

names.Leeza: collects the absent-students data and makes the pictograph and bar graph

maths_rules: only Class 5 has 0 absent, so it has no bar
video_script.design: One idea: zero is a value, and a bar of height zero cannot be seen. The graph stays on the board all video and an empty slot is marked at the foot of Class 5.

narration: <bookmark mark='book'/>This is a question from your book about the same bar graph.
<bookmark mark='graph'/>Leeza drew a bar for the students absent in each of eight classes.
<bookmark mark='ask'/>Which class had full attendance that day?
<bookmark mark='mean'/>Full attendance means that every student of the class came to school.

beats.on_screen: the bar graph stays on the board and Keeko sits at the corner of the board

marks.think: Keeko sits at the corner of the board

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Think and tell.

beats.on_screen: three bars drawn on one base line: a bar of height 2, a bar of height 1 and a bar of height 0 that is only a flat line; labels 2 absent, 1 absent, none absent

marks.one: a bar of height 1 appears beside it
marks.zero: a flat line with no height appears and is tagged none absent

narration: <bookmark mark='two'/>A bar of height two shows two students absent.
<bookmark mark='one'/>A bar of height one shows one student absent.
<bookmark mark='zero'/>When no student is absent, the bar has no height at all. It is only the flat line it stands on.

beats.on_screen: Given: the bar graph of students absent in each class; 1 unit length = 1 student

marks.given: the words the bar graph of students absent in each class are written
marks.unit: the words 1 unit length = 1 student are written

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, the graph shows the students absent in each class.
<bookmark mark='unit'/>One unit of length stands for one student.

beats.on_screen: To find: the class with full attendance

marks.find: the words the class with full attendance are written

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to find the class with full attendance.

beats.on_screen: Step 1: full attendance = 0 students absent, so we look for a bar of height 0

marks.full: the words full attendance = 0 students absent are written
marks.look: a zero mark is shown on the left line

narration: <bookmark mark='full'/>Step one, turn the question into a number, because the graph shows the students absent.
<bookmark mark='look'/>Full attendance means zero students absent, so we look for a bar of height zero.

beats.on_screen: Step 2: the bars of 7 classes reach 3, 5, 4, 2, 1, 5 and 7; one place has no bar

marks.seven: seven bars light up one by one
marks.gap: one place on the line has no bar and is circled

narration: <bookmark mark='seven'/>Step two, check the bars one by one. Seven of them have some height, so some students were absent in those classes.
<bookmark mark='gap'/>Only one place on the line has no bar at all.

beats.on_screen: Step 3: read the label at the empty place: Class 5

marks.label: the label under the empty place is circled

narration: <bookmark mark='label'/>Step three, read the label under that empty place, because the question asks which class.
<bookmark mark='name'/>The label says Class five.
<bookmark mark='pay'/>Class five had full attendance.

beats.on_screen: Keeko with a raised hand beside the bar graph
narration: <bookmark mark='hand'/>Keeko has raised a hand. Let us check the doubt and solve it.

beats.on_screen: Keeko's bubble says Class 5 has no bar, so its count was left out; the left line is marked 0 beside the empty place and the bubble is struck through

marks.zero: the left line is marked 0 beside the empty place and the bubble is struck through
marks.count: the words 0 students absent appear at the empty place

narration: <bookmark mark='doubt'/>Keeko thinks Class five has no bar, so its count was left out.
<bookmark mark='zero'/>But the count was not left out, because zero is a number too. Zero is the mark at the foot of the left line.
<bookmark mark='count'/>Zero students absent gives a bar with no height, so there is nothing to see.
